question: Does the unfitted A^4 response explain the inspected Test 7 residual and predict a new locked radial waveform and local marker record?

method.action: Unchanged SS OCF 1 discrete radial Hamiltonian. Formal Taylor coefficients neutral odd A,A^3 and core/clock even A^0,A^2,A^4; exact quadrature phase series; no fitted coefficient.
method.units: c=hbar=m=1, r and t in m^-1, phase divided by 2*pi is cycles.
method.domain: Frozen Test 6 base/fine modes at R=80, h=.1,.05,.025 (finest interpolated profile); local r=.1; upstream r=14.
method.boundaries: Regular origin and zero outer radial fields. T=65; earliest boundary reflection cannot reach local probe.
method.initial_data: Held-out center 22, width 3.25, A=+.004,-.004,+.006; neutral field b=r*a starts exterior to surface, b_t=b_r; fixed clock phase 0 and amplitude .001.
method.solver: RK4 dt=.01,.01,.005 plus independent dt=.005 at coarse; output .05 and decimated .1 interpolation control; optical travel-time inversion with known exterior Z, with vacuum inversion saved as control. Fourth-order formal ODE integrated on quiet history. Prior Test 7 evidence is diagnostic only.
method.tolerances: Fresh held-out record and marker criteria specified below; the prior Test 7 failures and thresholds stay fixed. First-rise/last-fall local |a|=1e-4, quiet-phase counterfactual.

hypotheses.prediction: Derived fourth-order sign and A^4 amplitude behavior predict the fresh held-out phase and interval within predeclared numerical and marker tolerances.
Residual persists after fourth-order term, temporal interpolation and known exterior Z control, or markers fail; response extension remains insufficient.
